title: Comfort Club Missed-Visit Fee Reduction for Kept Tune-Ups
content:
A Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements member who has kept their tune-ups receives a reduction on a missed-visit fee.

**Attendance rule.** Count the completed cooling or heating tune-ups on the agreement dated within the 24 months before the date of handling.

| Completed cooling or heating tune-ups in the 24 months | Attendance reduction |
|---|---|
| Four or more | 5.00 USD (the four-visit reduction) |
| Two or three | 3.00 USD (the two-visit reduction) |
| Fewer than two | none |

Whole-home visits and forfeited visits are not completed cooling or heating tune-ups and are not counted.

## Cases (hypothetical members)
- Four seasonal tune-ups over the last two years: 5.00 taken off.
- Three: 3.00 taken off. Two: 3.00 taken off.
- One completed tune-up and two whole-home visits: no reduction.
